q1.question: How long does the insurance application approval process take?
q1.answer: For standard applications, our AI can approve in 3 minutes. For cases requiring manual review (pre-existing conditions, high sum assured), maximum 24 working hours.

q2.question: Are there any hidden fees?
q2.answer: None! All fees are clearly stated in the quote. The premium you see is the final price to pay, including taxes and admin fees.

q3.question: How do I file a claim?
q3.answer: Very easy! Login to your dashboard, click "File Claim", upload photos/documents, and submit. For simple claims, our AI can approve in 3 minutes. Our team will contact you immediately for complex claims.

q4.question: Can I bundle multiple insurance products?
q4.answer: Yes! We encourage customers to bundle. Bundle discounts can reach 25% for combinations of 3 or more products. For example: Life + Health + Vehicle = save up to Rp 500,000/year.

q5.question: How do I cancel my policy?
q5.answer: You can cancel anytime without penalty in the first 14 days (cooling-off period). After that, cancellation can be done through the dashboard with prorated refund according to remaining policy period.

q6.question: Is my personal data safe?
q6.answer: Data security is our top priority. We use bank-level encryption (256-bit SSL), compliance with OJK regulations, and never share your data with third parties without permission.
